name: ui-graph-canvas
description: GraphCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui graph-canvas pattern).

schema.description: GraphCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui graph-canvas pattern).
schema.name: ui-graph-canvas

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

description.description: Text alternative for the graph, rendered as visually hidden text and linked by aria-describedby.
description.label: Description

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

linkDistance.description: Force-sim target edge length (larger ⇒ more spread out)
linkDistance.label: Link Distance

linkOpacity.description: Base opacity for links when nothing is hovered (kept faint so dense graphs stay readable; incident links brighten on hover).
linkOpacity.label: Link Opacity

nodeSpacing.description: Minimum empty gap (px) enforced between node edges so nodes never overlap.
nodeSpacing.label: Node Spacing

onBadgeClick.description: On node badge click (e.g. to expand a merged cluster).
onBadgeClick.label: On Badge Click

onMarkClick.description: On marked-node click (suggestion/proposal target). Takes priority over onNodeClick.
onMarkClick.label: On Mark Click

onNodeDoubleClick.description: On node double-click (e.g. to drill in)
onNodeDoubleClick.label: On Node Double Click

proposedEdges.description: Uncommitted proposal links — rendered dashed/faint in a separate pass, never folded into the layout springs.
proposedEdges.label: Proposed Edges

repulsion.description: Force-sim repulsion strength between nodes (larger ⇒ more spread out)
repulsion.label: Repulsion

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

similarity.description: All-pairs similarity (cosine 0–1) used ONLY for layout, never drawn. It is the secondary macro-layout: non-connected pairs get a weak spring (higher cosine ⇒ closer) so clusters arrange relative to each other; drawn `edges` stay the primary tight structure. When omitted, edges alone drive the layout.
similarity.label: Similarity

skeleton.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.
skeleton.label: Skeleton

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

viewerRole.description: The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role

emits.description: On marked-node click (suggestion/proposal target). Takes priority over onNodeClick.
On node double-click (e.g. to drill in)
On node badge click (e.g. to expand a merged cluster).

events.description: On marked-node click (suggestion/proposal target). Takes priority over onNodeClick.
events.name: @config.on mark click

events.description: On node double-click (e.g. to drill in)
events.name: @config.on node double click

events.description: On node badge click (e.g. to expand a merged cluster).
events.name: @config.on badge click
